Package com.framed.interop.hl7.hl7v2

Class Hl7Message

java.lang.Object
com.framed.interop.hl7.hl7v2.Hl7Message
public final class Hl7Message extends Object
A lightweight, read-oriented HL7 v2 pipe-encoded message: a list of segments, each split into fields on |. Components (^) and repetitions (~) are exposed as raw field text for callers to split as needed.

Field numbering follows HL7's convention. For most segments field n is at array index n (index 0 being the segment id). MSH is special: its first | is field 1 (the field separator), so MSH-n for n >= 2 lives at array index n - 1. field(String, int) hides this difference.
